install.title: iPhone Clipboard
install.step1: 1. Copy this computer's URL first. Importing a shortcut asks for it:
install.step2: 2. Install both shortcuts and paste the URL when asked:
install.step3: Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap: set Double Tap to “%1” and Triple Tap to “%2”.
install.step4: The first time each shortcut runs, choose “Always Allow” for clipboard access.
